scope: Manual image review of actual browser captures: rendered game/menu/pause, controller icon, full actual fixture ID, and non-overlap of the primary action. Synthetic bridge, not native hardware.
controllerIdentity: Full ID wraps and stays readable in playing, paused, reconnect and both viewport sizes.
gameWorld: Actual original cars, track, ranking, minimap, lap/time, speed meter and boost gauge are rendered; no blank game canvas.
menuBehavior: Configuration and the full instruction card are inside a normal scrolling menu. The Start action remains fixed. At 960×540, the connected service-information footer uses the controller panel internal scroll area; the requested controller icon and entire ID remain visible.
limitations: The game displays its temporary control hint using an 18-second wall-clock timeout. On the slow software renderer it can expire before the countdown advances; the permanent menu instruction card remains available by scrolling.
This is not a claim that every configuration option or service-info line fits the initial 960 viewport without scrolling.
No full race completion is claimed by this controls suite; the recorded driving segment covers actual inputs and lifecycle checks.
